heading: Wednesday, February 19, 2025
topLine: Google's AI co-scientist proposes validated AML drug candidates and recovers an unpublished gene-transfer mechanism.

items.headline: Google's AI co-scientist proposes validated AML drug candidates and recovers an unpublished gene-transfer mechanism
items.summary: Google's Gemini-based multi-agent co-scientist proposed drug-repurposing candidates that inhibited acute myeloid leukaemia cell lines in vitro, epigenetic liver-fibrosis targets with anti-fibrotic activity in human hepatic organoids, and independently ranked first the 'tail piracy' mechanism of cf-PICI gene transfer that Jose Penades's Imperial College team had found but not published. The cf-PICI biology and the AI comparison appeared in Cell in September 2025 and the system paper in Nature in May 2026; the cf-PICI case is a rediscovery of an answer the humans already had, not a new one.
